modis.missing_cause: Processed masks cannot distinguish each cloud, glint, retrieval failure or missing acquisition. These are plausible mechanisms, not proven causes for individual gaps.
modis.handling: Missing values remain masked. Model inputs use zero standardized value plus observation flag 0. Missing targets remain class 255 and excluded from loss/scoring.

sentinel3.reason: Only CHL_OC4ME and dataMask were requested/retained. No per-pixel science/quality flags or independent source georeferencing are available in the saved bundle. dataMask and tile-level cloud filtering do not establish valid chlorophyll retrievals.
sentinel3.future_requirement: Acquire original OLCI water products and documented per-pixel quality flags; apply appropriate retrieval/cloud/land/glint checks before resampling, validate georeferencing and MODIS agreement on training/development data, preserve source provenance. No blind fusion or boundary-value clipping.

saved_sentinel_product: Sentinel Hub sentinel-3-olci-l2, CHL_OC4ME + dataMask export
saved_unit_conversion: LOG10_MILLIGRAMS_M3 decoded via 10**x after bilinear resampling of log10 values.
timestamp_limitation: Daily request windows saved, but individual acquisition IDs/times and processing baselines were not retained.

coordinates.conclusion: Bbox-derived centers agree numerically with project grid, but independent georeferencing was not saved; this does not validate each acquisition.

quality_controlled_sentinel.reason: No georeferenced observations with retained retrieval quality flags are available.

fusion_experiment: Not run: source retrieval flags/acquisition provenance unavailable. QC adapter exists, but coverage and classification improvements cannot be claimed.
